newsitem.title: USA: IMM CURRENCY FUTURES END DOWN IN RANGE-BOUND TRADE.
newsitem.headline: IMM CURRENCY FUTURES END DOWN IN RANGE-BOUND TRADE.

text.p: Most IMM currency futures ended lower in range-bound trade as the market consolidated after several sessions of topsy-turvy trade, analysts said.
"The ranges were very small and activity was very light," one currency futures trader said.
The September yen contract alone lost more than $0.000400 between Friday and Monday and is expected to gravitate lower in the near term, they said.
Traders and analysts said the International Monetary Fund's $16 billion aid package to Thailand lowered yen's status as a safe-haven currency.
Also, the decline in the Nikkei was viewed as a sign that Japan's economic recovery may be further away than previously anticipated.
Some traders look for losses in the Nikkei average to mount and push September yen to support at $0.008553 or 117.50 spot yen.

Sterling and Mexican pesos managed to hold gains throughout the session. Traders were reportedly buying sterling against marks after unwinding those positions last week and sending September sterling to a contract low of $1.5650 on Friday.
Sterling recovered, but will remain in a downtrend until it pierces the two-week high of $1.6420, technical analysts said.
September marks fell through support at $0.5390 again, and appear poised to fall further. Traders said U.S. dollar fundamentals remain positive.

Traders will get a better grasp of the state of the U.S. economy later this week when U.S. July retail sales and the Producer Price Index (PPI) will be released on Wednesday. The U.S. July Consumer Price Index (CPI) will be released on Thursday.

At the end of pit trade, September yen was off $0.000108 at $0.008658, marks were down $0.0041 at $0.5385, Swiss francs fell $0.0067 at $0.6583, sterling rose $0.0042 at $1.5882, Canadian dollars were $0.0018 lower at $0.7191, Australian dollars were $0.0036 higher at $0.7387 and Mexican pesos were up $0.000325 at $0.126475. ((Chicago Derivatives desk 312-408-8750))
